adjusted_prescription: The demonstration successfully shows how the agent can use the right-column corridor strategy to navigate safely through areas with dynamic fire hazards. Starting near the top-right corner, it follows the corridor by moving up along the rightmost column, then descending down that same column, and finally moving left toward the goal. This approach helps the agent learn to commit early to a safe, corridor-aligned path, effectively avoiding fires that appear in central and bottom rows. The demo highlights the importance of maintaining a consistent route along the corridor edge, even when fires are close by, ensuring safe and reliable navigation to the goal. Overall, this demonstration teaches the agent to generalize hazard avoidance across varying fire placements by following a predictable, corridor-based path.
